result.description: The Aurelia Flux 27 Pro is a fictional 27-inch studio monitor designed for color-critical illustration, CAD drafting, and ambient light sensing in boutique workspaces. It features a matte 5K IPS panel, a detachable control puck, dual USB-C inputs, and a silent fanless chassis tuned for long editing sessions. The display includes factory-calibrated wide-gamut coverage, an adjustable low-blue-light mode, and a memory profile system for switching between sketch, proofing, and presentation presets.
